# Compute share per angler by day and class
result_list = []
for (doy, cls), group in overnight_1d5.groupby(['fish_date_doy', 'cls']):
    total_yt = group['yt'].sum()
    total_anglers = group['anglers'].sum()
    n_trips = len(group)
    if total_anglers > 0:
        share_per_angler = total_yt / total_anglers
        result_list.append({'doy': doy, 'class': cls, 'trips': n_trips, 'fish': total_yt, 'anglers': total_anglers, 'share': share_per_angler})

import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame(result_list).sort_values('doy', ascending=False)
print("Share per angler (last 10d, long trips):")
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print()
